name: Multi-file version bump must land atomically
prompt:
Bump the project version from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0. This requires updating BOTH files: package.json (the "version" field) and CHANGELOG.md (add a line mentioning 1.1.0). A version bump that only touches one of the two files is incomplete.

Set package.json to exactly:
{"version": "1.1.0"}

Append a line to CHANGELOG.md containing the text 1.1.0.

metadata.author: VASB maintainers
metadata.rationale: Some tasks are only correct when several files move together. The bad path updates package.json but forgets CHANGELOG.md - a partial, inconsistent change that correctness must catch even though one of the two required edits genuinely happened.
